turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Jordan calling from Maple Bank. This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: May I speak with Cynthia Cruz?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Speaking.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Before we continue, can you please confirm your date of birth?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, it's June 18, 1986.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. And is your mailing address still the same?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, same address.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. I'm calling about your account with Maple Bank, which is past due.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Give me a second while I open your file.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, I see a account here.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The amount past due today is $6,510.84.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'm not able to pay that right now. I've been on medical leave since Oct.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. We have hardship options, like a reduced payment for three months. Would you like me to review that with you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that would help.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'll make a note on a file so the hardship team can review your situation.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You should hear from them within a few business days.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I can pay $4030 the 17th.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Just to confirm, a payment of $4,030.00 on March 17. I'll send you a payment link.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you any other questions for me?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, I think that's it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for your time today. You'll receive a confirmation by text. Have a good evening.
